item.title: Suspicious package causes Main Street Centre evacuation
item.description: Main Street Centre was evacuated on Wednesday after Capitol Police were alerted to a suspicious package in the building.

item.title: Family still without answers in decades-old Ashland murder case
item.description: It's been nearly a quarter of a century since Truman Stanley was killed in his Hanover County home. His family remains desperate for answers.

item.title: 'Please help': Residents say elevators in Henrico senior living apartments have been broken for weeks
item.description: Elevators in an independent senior living complex have been broken for what residents say has been weeks. Residents of the Parham Park Place senior apartments in Henrico say without elevators, getting in and out is nearly impossible.

item.title: Volunteers needed to read to Richmond, Henrico kids for 'Read Across America'
item.description: A Richmond sorority is looking for volunteers to bring the joy of reading to Central Virginia children during "Read Across America 2026" in early March.

item.title: Chesterfield native to 'wreak a lot of carnage' in upcoming horror film
item.description: A Chesterfield County native will appear in an upcoming horror film, with a local red carpet premiere set for Sunday.

item.title: Dozen New Kent neighborhoods may see week of water pressure issues due to tank cleaning
item.description: A dozen New Kent County neighborhoods may experience water pressure issues for a week while a local tank is cleaned.

item.title: Richmond International Airport announces $253.1M security checkpoint project
item.description: As the region continues to grow, Richmond International Airport (RIC) has announced some upcoming projects to combat the development.

item.title: 'It doesn't sit right': Richmond restaurant hit with $50K water bill after billing error
item.description: After serving the Richmond Fan District for more than a decade, Social 52 Kitchen and Craft Bar was billed more than $50,000 for water in one month.

item.title: Woman hit, killed by train while walking along tracks in Richmond, police say
item.description: A woman was hit and killed by a train while walking along the tracks in Richmond's Southside on Wednesday, according to police.

item.title: Possible solutions for Shockoe Bottom safety discussed following mass shooting
item.description: On Wednesday, speaking for the first time publicly since the Shockoe Bottom mass shooting, Richmond City Council president Cynthia Newbille heard thoughts and recommendations from community members and business owners near where the shooting took place.
